en: Colorized historic postcard view of a town square with several adjoining multi‑story buildings in late 19th/early 20th century architectural style. The image shows shops at street level, ornate gables, tiled roofs and a small kiosk or guard hut in the middle of a largely empty market square. A few people, including women and children, are visible. Red printed captions at the top read the town and location name. German shop and restaurant signs are visible on the facades.
